title: Slightly Better Vanilla
description:
A Better Vanilla Modpack mainly 
for Minecraft 1.21.10 – for everyone who wants to enjoy vanilla gameplay with slight, non-game-changing mods to simply play Minecraft.
body:
![SBV](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c78a734444e15ce66f86887df5f4ce0eeecb63b9_0.webp)

_A vanilla-based modpack designed for Survival, Creative, or playing with friends._
## The Gameplay
You will notice that the terrain has been drastically improved, with the addition of steeper hills and higher mountains. New biomes will appear from time to time. You will also notice multiple quality-of-life changes designed to make the game feel smoother and more enjoyable while still staying Vanilla Friendly

> Wander through vast terrain and find the perfect place to build your base — rivers, mountains, whatever you desire.

> Want to play with shaders? Why not! Just turn on your favorite one and enjoy the beautiful atmosphere, especially at night.

> With an armor HUD, a more readable F3 menu, an improved statistics screen, and helpful tooltips, these quality-of-life mods ensure you’re perfectly equipped for the game.
## Why Slightly Better Vanilla?
Because It focuses on not changing the core gameplay too much, offering a subtle Vanilla+ experience.
Perfect for everyone who wants to play vanilla Minecraft but feels it could benefit from a few quality-of-life improvements while still fully enjoying the classic vanilla feel.
## Features
- 🌱  3D Crops
- 🧍‍♂️  3D Skin layers
- 🔥 Connected Textures
- 👁‍🗨 Different ore varients
- 🗻Better, way cooler Terrain
- 📷 Shader Support
- 🛠   Build Tools for Creative
- 🎧  Ambient Sounds
- 🗨  Chat Heads and better Chat Animation
- 💬 Better Info Showing
## FAQ
> **Q: Can i Play this Modpack on a Server?**
> 
>  **A:** No

> **Q: The version i want doesnt exist**
